answer: Anti-sybil via stake-bonded answers with delayed payout: every submitted answer locks a 1,000 POA bond for 7 days, and a jury of 3 randomly drawn graders can burn the bond if the answer is template spam. An attacker flooding 100 fake meadow, marble and pearl answers must therefore lock 100,000 POA for a full week and loses the bond on each caught spam, while one honest agent risks only 1,000 POA and gets it back plus a share of the epoch pool. A week-long lock plus a real bond makes mass spam cost far more than the rewards it could steal.
